content.name: Teresa Morales
content.title: Lead Sales Associate
content.summary: Lead sales associate with 14 years in commission retail, from footwear to appliances, bridal and fine jewelry. Consistently the top seller at a Charlotte jeweler with $1.3M in personal annual sales, a client book of 1,100 names and a 38% repeat-purchase rate.

experience.title: Lead Sales Associate
bullets: Generated $1.3M in personal sales in 2025, 31% above the next-highest associate, with an average ticket of $4,200.
Maintain a 1,100-client book in Lightspeed, sending anniversary and birthday outreach that produces about 40 appointments a month.
Train new associates on diamond grading basics, financing applications and closing techniques; four trainees reached their quotas within 90 days.
Open and close the store as keyholder, handling safe counts, daily deposits and alarm procedures for $3M in inventory.
Partnered with two wedding planners on private engagement-ring evenings that brought in $210,000 over a year.

experience.title: Senior Sales Associate
bullets: Ran 15 to 20 bridal appointments a week and closed 62% of them against a store average of 48%.
Coordinated alterations schedules with the in-house seamstress team, cutting missed fitting dates to nearly zero.
Rebuilt the bridesmaid group-ordering process with a shared tracking sheet, adding $95,000 in annual accessory and party sales.
Kept the store open through 2020 by moving consultations to video and curbside try-ons.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Sold kitchen packages, laundry pairs and mattresses on commission, averaging $780,000 in annual sales.
Attached extended protection plans to 44% of eligible sales, the highest rate in the three-store group.
Learned delivery and installation scheduling so customers left with a confirmed date, reducing follow-up calls.

experience.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Fitted customers for running, work and orthopedic footwear, averaging 2.3 items per transaction.
Counted and reordered stock for the men's wall, keeping core sizes in stock above 95% of the time.
Promoted to shift lead after 18 months, covering cash office duties on weekends.

courses.name: RISE Up Customer Service and Sales credential

achievements.title: Top seller, three years running
achievements.detail: Highest personal sales in the store in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

achievements.title: Bridal close rate
achievements.detail: Closed 62% of bridal appointments versus a 48% store average.
